page.overview:
Who is Belcha?

To battle Belcha, Dixie and Kiddy Kong must start out with falling down a trapdoor to encounter Belcha. It then proceeds to burp out Knik-Knaks in barrels at the Kongs to attack and the Kongs must continue throwing Knik-Knaks in Belcha's mouth. If missed, Belcha jumps forward, forcing the player to get closer to a spiky enemy in the Game Boy Advance version or just a pit in the SNES version. If the Kongs reach there and Belcha reaches the last rest of the floor, the Kongs lose a life. The Kongs must keep throwing Knik-Knaks in Belcha's mouth until Belcha's belch recoil makes it fall into a pit. Afterwards the Kongs can gain a Kremkoin as a reward.
